svg.title: How it works: write, crop, clean, transcribe
svg.text: Draw on the canvas, upload a photo,
Trim the image to the ink and keep a
40 px border, so the model sees only
and the rest turn white. Then scale
Texify reads it in your browser, or
Claude reads it in the cloud.
